title: SS Normandie 郵輪工程史
summary: 以Normandie歷史客輪檔案為案例，研究外形、能源與服務空間如何在不同證據中呈現；教學數值獨立於檔案尺寸和原廠性能。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Normandie archival material to examine how hull form, energy and service spaces appear in different evidence sources; teaching values remain independent of archival dimensions and original performance. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 標示縮尺展示不能直接外推阻力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Mark why exhibit scale does not directly predict drag: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 標示縮尺展示不能直接外推阻力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Mark why exhibit scale does not directly predict drag and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 標示縮尺展示不能直接外推阻力：自由液面重力效應以弗勞德數V/√(gL)比較；同時滿足雷諾相似通常困難。 本步以「縮尺試驗的弗勞德數」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Mark why exhibit scale does not directly predict drag: Free-surface gravity effects are compared using Froude number V/√(gL); simultaneous Reynolds similarity is usually difficult. Use Froude similarity in scale testing to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是SS Normandie 郵輪工程史實際規格：速度V=2.12 m/s、長度L=20 m、g=9.81 m/s²。式 Fr=V/√(gL)，基準結果 0.15135137 dimensionless。條件：自由液面相似指標；不能由此直接把模型摩擦阻力全比例放大。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of SS Normandie liner engineering history: Speed V=2.12 m/s, length L=20 m, g=9.81 m/s². Formula Fr=V/√(gL) gives 0.15135137 dimensionless. Conditions: Free-surface similarity parameter; it does not directly scale all model friction drag.
steps.failure: 線性縮小速度而不是平方根縮放會破壞重力相似；檢查兩邊Fr。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Scaling speed linearly rather than with the square root breaks gravity similarity; compare both Froude numbers. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 先以相同比例寫出模型與原型長度，再推導速度應依長度平方根縮放。 本案例另須檢查「標示縮尺展示不能直接外推阻力」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Write model/prototype length ratio first, then derive speed scaling with the square root of length. Also check that Mark why exhibit scale does not directly predict drag and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：標示縮尺展示不能直接外推阻力。在歷史平面圖連結、原創船體模型與能量帳完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加模型速度10%，比較Fr，並說明黏性相似仍未解決。 算式區的基準值為0.15135137，改變後為0.16648651 dimensionless。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Mark why exhibit scale does not directly predict drag. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Archive-plan links, original hull model and energy ledger. Increase model speed alone by 10%, compare Fr and explain that viscous similarity remains unresolved. Baseline 0.15135137 changes to 0.16648651 dimensionless. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「SS Normandie 郵輪工程史」的「標示縮尺展示不能直接外推阻力：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「船塢學院：一艘模型的交付」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Mark why exhibit scale does not directly predict drag: Mechanism and observation” in “SS Normandie liner engineering history”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Dockyard Academy: Deliver a Scale Model” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

Write model/prototype length ratio first, then derive speed scaling with the square root of length. Also check that Mark why exhibit scale does not directly predict drag and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Mark why exhibit scale does not directly predict drag with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 線性縮小速度而不是平方根縮放會破壞重力相似；檢查兩邊Fr。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.instructionEn: Scaling speed linearly rather than with the square root breaks gravity similarity; compare both Froude numbers. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.

steps.title: 區分登記噸位與排水質量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Separate registered tonnage and displacement mass: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 區分登記噸位與排水質量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Separate registered tonnage and displacement mass and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 區分登記噸位與排水質量：靜浮平衡時船舶總質量等於排開水的質量；載重、設備、燃料和船體質量應分欄。 本步以「船舶排水質量帳」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Separate registered tonnage and displacement mass: At static flotation, vessel mass equals displaced-water mass; payload, equipment, fuel and hull belong in separate ledger columns. Use Vessel displacement mass ledger to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是SS Normandie 郵輪工程史實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³，排水體積V=530 m³。式 m=ρV，基準結果 543.25 t。條件：僅靜水質量平衡；不等於總噸位，也未判定完整穩度。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of SS Normandie liner engineering history: ρ=1025 kg/m³, displacement volume V=530 m³. Formula m=ρV gives 543.25 t. Conditions: Static mass balance only; this is not gross tonnage and does not establish intact stability.
steps.failure: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 以四欄裝載表加總後與排水質量比對，標出尚未計入的人員、淡水與備品。 本案例另須檢查「區分登記噸位與排水質量」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Sum a four-column loading table and compare with displacement mass; flag omitted people, freshwater and spares. Also check that Separate registered tonnage and displacement mass and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：區分登記噸位與排水質量。在歷史平面圖連結、原創船體模型與能量帳完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水體積10%，重算可平衡的質量，不推定可額外載客。 算式區的基準值為543.25，改變後為597.575 t。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Separate registered tonnage and displacement mass. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Archive-plan links, original hull model and energy ledger. Increase displacement volume alone by 10% and recalculate equilibrium mass without inferring additional passenger capacity. Baseline 543.25 changes to 597.575 t. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.
